classes.name: StepSelect_Activator
classes.summary: Performs Actions specific to StepSelect, i.e. creation of Step Selections and Counters, plus dumping specific to Step.

instanceMethods.name: Do
instanceMethods.comment: Executes a Command Line for StepSelect.

instanceMethods.name: Help
instanceMethods.comment: Sends a short help message for StepSelect commands.

instanceMethods.name: Perform
instanceMethods.comment:
Perform the action specific to each class of File Modifier <ctx> is the ContextWrite, which brings : the model, the protocol, the file name, plus the object AppliedModifiers (not used here) and the CheckList Remark that the model has to be casted for specific access.
<writer> is the Writer and is specific to each norm, on which to act

classes.name: StepSelect_FloatFormat
classes.summary: This class gives control out format for floatting values : ZeroSuppress or no, Main Format, Format in Range (for values around 1.), as StepWriter allows to manage it. Formats are given under C-printf form.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a new FloatFormat, with standard options : ZeroSuppress, Main Format = E, Format between 0.001 and 1000. = f.

instanceMethods.name: SetDefault
instanceMethods.comment: Sets FloatFormat to default value (see Create) but if <digits> is given positive, it commands Formats (main and range) to ensure <digits> significant digits to be displayed.

instanceMethods.name: SetZeroSuppress
instanceMethods.comment: Sets ZeroSuppress mode to a new value.

instanceMethods.name: SetFormat
instanceMethods.comment: Sets Main Format to a new value Remark : SetFormat, SetZeroSuppress and SetFormatForRange are independent.

instanceMethods.name: SetFormatForRange
instanceMethods.signature: (format?: string, Rmin?: number, Rmax?: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: Sets Format for Range to a new value with its range of application. To cancel it, give format as "" (empty string) Remark that if the condition (0. < Rmin < Rmax) is not verified, this secondary format will be ignored. Moreover, this secondary format is intended to be used in a range around 1.

instanceMethods.name: Format
instanceMethods.signature: (zerosup: boolean, mainform: TCollection_AsciiString, hasrange: boolean, forminrange: TCollection_AsciiString, rangemin: number, rangemax: number): { zerosup: boolean; hasrange: boolean; rangemin: number; rangemax: number }
instanceMethods.returnType: { zerosup: boolean; hasrange: boolean; rangemin: number; rangemax: number }

instanceMethods.name: Perform
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the Floatting Formats of StepWriter to the recorded parameters.

instanceMethods.name: Label
instanceMethods.comment: Returns specific Label : for instance, "Float Format [ZeroSuppress] %E [, in range R1-R2 %f]".

classes.name: StepSelect_StepType
classes.summary: StepType is a Signature specific to Step definitions : it considers the type as defined in STEP Schemas, the same which is used in files. For a Complex Type, if its definition is known, StepType produces the list of basic types, separated by commas, the whole between brackets : "(TYPE1,TYPE2..)". If its precise definition is not known (simply it is known as Complex, it can be recognised, but the list is produced at Write time only), StepType produces : "(..COMPLEX TYPE..)".

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a Signature for Step Type. Protocol is undefined here, hence no Signature may yet be produced. The StepType signature requires a Protocol before working.

instanceMethods.name: SetProtocol
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the StepType signature to work with a Protocol : this initialises the library.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Step Type defined from the Protocol (see above). If <ent> is not recognised, produces "..NOT FROM SCHEMA <name>..".

classes.name: StepSelect_WorkLibrary
classes.summary: Performs Read and Write a STEP File with a STEP Model Following the protocols, Copy may be implemented or not.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a STEP WorkLibrary <copymode> precises whether Copy is implemented or not.

instanceMethods.name: SetDumpLabel
instanceMethods.comment: Selects a mode to dump entities 0 (D) : prints numbers, then displays table number/label 1 : prints labels, then displays table label/number 2 : prints labels onky.

instanceMethods.name: ReadFile
instanceMethods.signature: (name: string, protocol: Interface_Protocol): { returnValue: number; model: Interface_InterfaceModel; [Symbol.dispose](): void }
instanceMethods.comment:
Reads a STEP File and returns a STEP Model (into <mod>), or lets <mod> "Null" in case of Error Returns 0 if OK, 1 if Read Error, -1 if File not opened.
@returns A result object with fields:
- `returnValue`: the C++ return value
- `model`: owned by the returned envelope.
Dispose the returned envelope to release owned Handle fields.

instanceMethods.name: WriteFile
instanceMethods.comment: Writes a File from a STEP Model Returns False (and writes no file) if <ctx> does not bring a STEP Model.
